fishing: WHEN: Sun Oct 25 NE breezes 15-20kt+, fish protected waters. PASSES-BEACH: residual wind; redfish near passes on live shrimp/pilchards or artificials; some pompano in surf. LEMON BAY: redfish, snook, trout around docks/mangroves/oyster bars; mangrove snapper at Chadwick Pier; protected bays best. NEARSHORE: limited windows, Spanish mackerel 1-2 mi off; mangrove/lane snapper on reefs when open. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, gold spoons.
redtide: FWC Oct 23: K. brevis at background offshore Lee County. Bloom concentrations first this season in 2 samples NW FL St. Joseph Bay (Gulf Co). No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 30.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, sample ~Oct 5). No advisory. Manasota Key / Palm Island similar good.
fpl: Charlotte ~1-2, Sarasota ~28-30 outages (minor/isolated, recent trackers); small only, no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
